messages:
anya: Quick preflight before we push zeta-70b to prod-dedicated. TL;DR: need confirmations on weights path, tokenizer gating, max_ctx & kv cache format, and memory headroom. I've copied checklist below — pls reply with ✅/🟡/❌ and a 1-line note.

anya: Checklist:
- weights uploaded to s3://rwd-models/zeta-70b/v1 ✅? (owner: liam)
- tokenizer files present + special pad token mapping? (owner: katie)
- config.json matches serving schema (seq_len, kv_cache_format, dtype) (owner: sandeep)
- max_ctx set to 131072? memory estimate ok? (owner: liam)
- fallback smaller variant ready (e.g., zeta-70b-quant) (owner: eng-ml)

liam: weights are in place at s3://rwd-models/zeta-70b/v1 — md5s match. did a quick load test on staging: model init ~ 42s on p4d. ✅

katie: tokenizer has weird BOS vs PAD behavior. patched tokenizer.json to set pad_token="<pad>" and added mappings for trailing spaces. see snippet:
```
{ "pad_token": "<pad>", "params": {"strip_accents": false} }
```
I pushed PR #472 to tokenizers repo. needs review from @sandeep.

sandeep: reviewing PR, noticed vocab size off by 2 (weird). Will confirm if that triggers kv cache alignment issues. Also schema check: kv_cache_format must be "packed" for 131072, otherwise memory blowup. recommend `kv_cache_format: "packed"` and `kv_cache_shard=2` for dedicated pool.

build-bot: upload completed for s3://rwd-models/zeta-70b/v1 at 2026-03-17T10:02:05Z (size: 146GB)

liam: memory calc: for seq=131072, bs=1, kv packed + 16-bit, estimated GPU VRAM ~ 58GB for KV + 12GB model weights (quant), total ~70GB — still risky on 80GB nodes if other processes present. suggest bump node to 96GB or enable spilling to host.

anya: ok so action items:
- @liam escalate node type to 96GB for canary
- @katie get tokenizer PR merged
- @sandeep update serving config: kv_cache_format=packed, kv_shards=2, max_ctx=131072
- @liam run one canary with seq=65k and one with 131k

sandeep: I'll also add a config validation rule to reject `kv_cache_format: naive` for seq > 65536. Will push to runtime config-lint.

katie: merged token PR and tag v1.1. added unit test for trailing-space tokenization.

liam: starting canary runs now on staging. will paste perf logs in a follow-up.

anya: thanks everyone. If canary looks good, I'll schedule a short maintenance window for prod push. :calendar:
